title: Reproduce and bound process-queue saturation from overlapping periodic work
goal: A controlled slow-child regression shows which background producers fill the nervous process queue, and an overlap guard keeps them bounded without widening the bound or a timeout
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression fails before the fix with the observed saturation and passes after it
Per-producer request counts under a stalled child name the producers
The process queue bound (MAX_CHILD_REQUESTS) and every timeout stay unchanged
A decision made while a resumable poll is out is still seen without waiting for the next resumer tick
Windows and full-suite CI pass on the PR
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: test/periodic-overlap.test.ts fails before the fix and passes after it
Affected resume, Kaji link, Kaji run, clarification and watch regressions; full deterministic CI including Windows
Fresh-context design review before the parent is verified
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or the queue bound, or weaken assertions
Keep the parent open until Windows runs on main show no recurrence
